thread:
casey_ops: Heads-up: Polaris shipped a mixed batch to APAC. 14 H100s received at KIX-hub, 5 units failing POST. Vendor proposing 3 air to NRT-depot for swap, 2 sea-return. Need decision on expedite split and insurance. @dylan_procurement @pei_logistics

dylan_procurement: Request serials, DOA photos, and a per-unit air quote. Also ask whether vendor will declare value and who covers duties/insurance if we expedite. Charge to infra-capex?

pei_logistics: If air, route to NRT-depot-2 for bench swap. Depot requires manifest_v2 CSV + 12h pre-alert. No crossdock. ETA ~36h after AWB. Carrier options: NH or SQ.

mira_platform: Impact note: JP pool = 88 H100s. Losing 5 is ~5.7% capacity; recommend reserving 2 hot-spares for 48h if air. Est $950/day. Approve?

casey_ops: Vendor note: failures = "no POST / PSU" for the 5. Serials (redacted): H100-PL-901..H100-PL-905. Air quote = $17,200 + customs. Vendor requests 40% expedite split and asks us to handle AWB + customs.

dylan_procurement: 40% is high. Counter 25% if vendor covers customs and insurance and provides carrier invoice with surcharge breakdown. Require timestamped DOA photos and signed RMA form before expedite payment.

pei_logistics: Pre-alert CSV example:

AWB,Carrier,ShipFrom,ShipTo,ItemCount,Serials,HSCode,DeclaredValue,RMA_type
TBD,TBD,Polaris,NRT-depot-2,3,"H100-PL-901;H100-PL-902;H100-PL-903",84733000,255000,swap

Depot will reject shipments without this format.

mira_platform: If vendor accepts 25% + covers customs/insurance, proceed with air and I'll reserve 2 hot-spares. If vendor refuses, opt sea-return and schedule repair (~10 business days).

casey_ops: Uploaded vendor photos + initial runlogs: https://files.redwood.internal/rma/4001234567/ (placeholder). Vendor replied: "we'll accept 30% if Redwood issues AWB within 4h and signs PO addendum". Tagging legal if needed.

dylan_procurement: Counter-offer: 30% only if vendor provides carrier receipts and covers customs/insurance. No PO addendum until legal approves. Action items:
1) casey_ops - upload full serial manifest + timestamped DOA photos by 11:00 JST.
2) dylan_procurement - send PO counter + request carrier receipts.
3) pei_logistics - provision NRT-depot-2 slot conditional on AWB.
4) mira_platform - reserve 2 hot-spares if AWB issued.

ops_bot: Reminder set - follow up with Polaris in 4h if AWB or receipts not provided.

casey_ops: Chasing vendor now. Escalate to finance if vendor refuses receipts or insurance.
